title: Cuthbert in the Cooler
build: Contributor-supplied packed PRG, SYS4109; engine entry $1100; original release identity unknown

tools.emulator: plus4emu 1.2.11 (git 939e652) with kit/c16/codemap.patch, built without libsndfile, in the kit's server

accuracy.note: 60 written and 20 generated comments; weighted rate 13.2%; one additional unverifiable purpose is recorded as unknown

exclude: runtime: CPU/system work areas, generated screen and the enemy glyph scratch buffer at $1000-$102F. The retained BASIC/depacker code below the verified $1100 game entry is outside the game-engine analysis.

retained memory after the ten maze records, then a zero-filled gap before the graphics directory. The tail includes monitor instruction-name strings; the engine uses fixed map and graphics pointers outside this interval.
retained fill between the source graphics and the character set: predominantly repeating $FF/$00 patterns, beyond the source frames selected by the game.

runtime character slots: fire glyphs $69-$6C at $3B48, per-enemy shifted glyphs $CE-$F7 at $3E70, and the player glyphs $FA-$FF at $3FD0. Their shapes are copied from the authored source frames; the other high slots retain fill.

regions: game engine, with inline drawing arguments and local tables
seven enemy spawn addresses per units digit
source frame directory, player, explosion and enemy bitmaps with retained trailing bytes
static alphabet, pickups, walls, bonus and bomb glyphs
